overview: Goa is a coastal state on India's west coast known for its beaches, Portuguese colonial heritage, vibrant nightlife, and laid-back beach-shack culture. It blends North Goa's party scene with South Goa's quieter, upscale resorts.

attractions.name: Baga Beach
attractions.description: Popular beach in North Goa known for water sports, beach shacks, and nightlife.

attractions.name: Fort Aguada
attractions.description: 17th-century Portuguese fort with a lighthouse and panoramic sea views.

attractions.name: Basilica of Bom Jesus
attractions.description: UNESCO World Heritage church in Old Goa holding the relics of St. Francis Xavier.

attractions.name: Dudhsagar Waterfalls
attractions.description: One of India's tallest waterfalls, reachable by jeep safari through Mollem National Park.

attractions.name: Anjuna Flea Market
attractions.description: Famous Wednesday flea market for clothes, jewelry, and souvenirs.

food.name: Fish Thali
food.description: Traditional Goan plate with rice, fish curry, and sides.

food.name: Beach shack seafood
food.description: Grilled prawns, calamari, and kingfish at beachside shacks.

food.name: Bebinca
food.description: Traditional Goan layered dessert.

transport.description: Most popular way to explore Goa independently.
Convenient but pricier than self-drive.

travel_tips: Carry an international or Indian driving license if renting a two-wheeler.
North Goa is livelier and nightlife-focused; South Goa is calmer and more upscale.
Book beach shacks and resorts in advance during the December-January peak season.
Carry cash for flea markets and small shacks, though UPI is widely accepted now.
Respect local dress codes at churches and temples.

best_time_to_visit: March to June, and October to February for snow
overview: Manali is a Himalayan hill town in Himachal Pradesh, popular for snow-capped mountains, adventure sports, and as a gateway to Solang Valley, Rohtang Pass, and the Spiti Valley.

attractions.name: Solang Valley
attractions.description: Valley offering paragliding, zorbing, and skiing (in winter).

attractions.name: Rohtang Pass
attractions.description: High mountain pass with snow views, accessible by road permit in season.

attractions.name: Hadimba Temple
attractions.description: Ancient wooden temple set inside a cedar forest.

attractions.name: Old Manali
attractions.description: Bohemian lanes with cafes, live music, and craft shops along the river.

attractions.name: Jogini Waterfall Trek
attractions.description: Moderate trek through Vashisht village to a scenic waterfall.

food.name: Himachali Thali
food.description: Includes siddu, rajma-madra, and local lentils.

food.name: Momos and thukpa
food.description: Popular Tibetan-influenced street food in Old Manali.

food.name: Cafe brunch
food.description: Wood-fired pizzas and pancakes in Old Manali's riverside cafes.

transport.description: Economical way to reach nearby valleys.
Covers Solang Valley, Rohtang Pass, and nearby points in a day.

travel_tips: Carry warm layers even in summer, especially for Rohtang Pass and Solang Valley.
Rohtang Pass may need an online permit and can close due to weather.
Old Manali offers better cafe and nightlife options than the main town.
Altitude sickness is possible at high passes; acclimatize and stay hydrated.
Network connectivity can be patchy beyond the main town.

overview: Munnar offers misty tea-plantation hills in the Western Ghats, while Alleppey (Alappuzha) is famed for its backwaters and houseboat cruises through palm-fringed canals.

attractions.name: Tea Museum & Plantations, Munnar
attractions.description: Rolling tea estates with a museum on tea processing history.

attractions.name: Eravikulam National Park
attractions.description: Home to the endangered Nilgiri Tahr, with grassy hill trails.

attractions.name: Alleppey Houseboat Backwater Cruise
attractions.description: Overnight or day cruise through Kerala's backwaters on a traditional houseboat.

attractions.name: Kumarakom Bird Sanctuary
attractions.description: Wetland sanctuary near Vembanad Lake, good for birdwatching.

attractions.name: Top Station Viewpoint
attractions.description: Scenic viewpoint near Munnar overlooking the Western Ghats valley.

food.name: Kerala Sadya
food.description: Traditional vegetarian feast served on a banana leaf.

food.name: Karimeen Pollichathu
food.description: Pearl spot fish marinated and grilled in banana leaf.

food.name: Appam with stew
food.description: Fermented rice pancake served with vegetable or chicken stew.

transport.description: Convenient for the hilly Munnar roads and inter-city transfers.
Budget-friendly option connecting major Kerala towns.

travel_tips: Book houseboats directly with operators or verified portals to avoid overpricing.
Carry light woolens for early mornings in Munnar's hill climate.
Roads from Munnar to Alleppey are winding; plan ~4-5 hours travel time.
Try to time the backwater cruise for sunset views.
Mosquito repellent is recommended for evenings near the backwaters.

overview: Jaipur, the 'Pink City', is Rajasthan's capital known for its majestic forts, palaces, vibrant bazaars, and royal Rajput heritage.

attractions.name: Amber Fort
attractions.description: Hilltop fort-palace with mirrored halls and an elephant gate, overlooking Maota Lake.

attractions.name: Hawa Mahal
attractions.description: Iconic five-story 'Palace of Winds' with intricately latticed windows.

attractions.name: City Palace
attractions.description: Royal residence complex with museums of royal artifacts and costumes.

attractions.name: Jal Mahal
attractions.description: Palace appearing to float in the middle of Man Sagar Lake.

attractions.name: Johari Bazaar
attractions.description: Famous market for jewelry, textiles, and traditional Rajasthani handicrafts.

food.name: Dal Baati Churma
food.description: Classic Rajasthani combo of lentils, baked wheat balls, and sweet crumble.

food.name: Laal Maas
food.description: Fiery Rajasthani mutton curry.

food.name: Pyaaz Kachori
food.description: Crispy onion-stuffed pastry, a Jaipur breakfast staple.

transport.description: Easy way to get around the city and Old City lanes.
Useful for covering Amber Fort, Nahargarh, and Jaigarh in one day.

travel_tips: Start at Amber Fort early to avoid both crowds and the midday heat.
Bargaining is expected at bazaars; start at 40-50% of the quoted price.
Combine Nahargarh Fort visit with sunset for the best city views.
Modest clothing is advisable when visiting temples and the City Palace.
Summer afternoons (April-June) can exceed 40°C; plan indoor activities then.

best_time_to_visit: April to June, and September to October
overview: Paris, the 'City of Light', is famed for its art, architecture, fashion, and cuisine, anchored by icons like the Eiffel Tower, the Louvre, and the Seine.

attractions.name: Eiffel Tower
attractions.description: Iconic iron lattice tower with observation decks offering panoramic city views.

attractions.name: Louvre Museum
attractions.description: World's largest art museum, home to the Mona Lisa and Venus de Milo.

attractions.name: Notre-Dame Cathedral area
attractions.description: Gothic cathedral on Île de la Cité, still under post-fire restoration with viewable exteriors.

attractions.name: Montmartre & Sacré-Cœur
attractions.description: Artsy hilltop district with the basilica, street artists, and panoramic views.

attractions.name: Seine River Cruise
attractions.description: Boat cruise past major Parisian landmarks along the river.

food.name: Croissant & cafe breakfast
food.description: Classic French breakfast at a local boulangerie.

food.name: Steak-frites bistro dinner
food.description: Traditional bistro meal of steak and fries.

food.name: Cheese and wine tasting
food.description: Curated tasting of regional French cheeses and wines.

transport.description: Covers unlimited rides on the extensive Paris metro network.
Faster but pricier alternative to the metro.

travel_tips: Book skip-the-line tickets for the Louvre and Eiffel Tower in advance.
The Paris Museum Pass can save money if visiting 3+ museums.
Many museums are closed on Mondays or Tuesdays; check before planning.
Tipping is not mandatory in France as service is usually included.
Learn a few basic French phrases; it's appreciated by locals.

overview: Bangkok is Thailand's bustling capital, blending ornate temples and royal palaces with vibrant street markets, modern malls, and a renowned street-food scene.

attractions.name: Grand Palace & Wat Phra Kaew
attractions.description: Former royal residence complex housing the revered Emerald Buddha temple.

attractions.name: Wat Arun (Temple of Dawn)
attractions.description: Riverside temple famous for its porcelain-decorated spire, best seen at sunset.

attractions.name: Chatuchak Weekend Market
attractions.description: One of the world's largest weekend markets with thousands of stalls.

attractions.name: Chao Phraya River Cruise
attractions.description: Boat ride past riverside temples, palaces, and modern skyline.

attractions.name: Khao San Road
attractions.description: Famous backpacker street with food stalls, bars, and street performers.

food.name: Pad Thai street stall
food.description: Iconic stir-fried noodle dish from street vendors.

food.name: Tom Yum Goong
food.description: Spicy and sour Thai shrimp soup.

food.name: Mango sticky rice
food.description: Sweet coconut sticky rice with fresh mango.

transport.description: Efficient way to avoid Bangkok's notorious traffic.
Convenient for short hops, though Grab is more fairly metered.

travel_tips: Dress modestly (covered shoulders/knees) when visiting temples.
Agree on tuk-tuk fares before the ride starts.
Avoid drinking tap water; bottled water is cheap and widely available.
Songkran (mid-April) brings citywide water festivities but also higher prices.
Use the BTS/MRT during rush hour to skip traffic jams entirely.

overview: Bali is an Indonesian island known for lush rice terraces, Hindu temples, surf beaches, and a wellness and digital-nomad culture centered around Ubud and Canggu.

attractions.name: Tegallalang Rice Terraces
attractions.description: Iconic stepped green rice terraces near Ubud, popular for photos and short walks.

attractions.name: Uluwatu Temple
attractions.description: Cliffside temple with a sunset Kecak fire dance performance.

attractions.name: Tanah Lot Temple
attractions.description: Sea temple perched on a rock formation, iconic at sunset.

attractions.name: Mount Batur Sunrise Trek
attractions.description: Pre-dawn volcano hike rewarded with sunrise views over Bali.

attractions.name: Seminyak/Canggu Beach Clubs
attractions.description: Trendy beachfront clubs with pools, DJs, and sunset views.

food.name: Nasi Goreng
food.description: Indonesian fried rice with egg, vegetables, and choice of protein.

food.name: Babi Guling
food.description: Traditional Balinese roasted suckling pig.

food.name: Smoothie bowl cafe
food.description: Popular among the wellness-cafe scene in Ubud and Canggu.

transport.description: Most flexible way to explore the island, though traffic can be hectic.
Comfortable option for families or longer day trips.

travel_tips: Carry a sarong; it's required (or rentable) at most temples.
Negotiate scooter rental rates for multi-day rentals.
Ubud is best for culture/wellness; Canggu/Seminyak for beach and nightlife.
Avoid driving in Bali without an international driving permit due to strict checks.
Rice terraces and temples often request a small voluntary donation.

best_time_to_visit: March to May (cherry blossoms), September to November (autumn colors)
overview: Tokyo is Japan's hyper-modern capital, mixing futuristic skyscrapers and neon districts with traditional temples, gardens, and an incomparable food culture.

attractions.name: Senso-ji Temple, Asakusa
attractions.description: Tokyo's oldest temple with the iconic Kaminarimon gate and Nakamise shopping street.

attractions.name: Shibuya Crossing & district
attractions.description: World-famous scramble crossing surrounded by shops, cafes, and neon billboards.

attractions.name: TeamLab Planets/Borderless
attractions.description: Immersive digital art museum with interactive light installations.

attractions.name: Tsukiji Outer Market
attractions.description: Bustling market famous for fresh sushi breakfast and street snacks.

attractions.name: Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden
attractions.description: Spacious landscaped garden, especially scenic during cherry blossom and autumn seasons.

food.name: Conveyor-belt sushi
food.description: Affordable and fun way to sample fresh sushi varieties.

food.name: Ramen shop
food.description: Rich tonkotsu, shoyu, or miso ramen bowls from specialty shops.

food.name: Izakaya dinner
food.description: Casual Japanese pub-style dining with small plates and drinks.

transport.description: Tap-and-go card covering trains, subways, and buses across the city.
Useful for day trips just outside central Tokyo.

travel_tips: Get a Suica or Pasmo IC card immediately on arrival for seamless transit.
Avoid eating or talking loudly on trains; it's considered impolite.
Cash is still useful; not every small shop accepts cards.
Book popular attractions like TeamLab well in advance online.
Pocket Wi-Fi or an eSIM is recommended for easy navigation.

best_time_to_visit: April to June, and September to October
overview: Rome, Italy's ancient capital, is an open-air museum of Roman ruins, Renaissance art, and Vatican treasures, paired with classic trattoria dining and piazza culture.

attractions.name: Colosseum & Roman Forum
attractions.description: Iconic ancient amphitheater and adjoining ruins of the Roman political center.

attractions.name: Vatican Museums & Sistine Chapel
attractions.description: Vast art collection culminating in Michelangelo's Sistine Chapel ceiling.

attractions.name: Trevi Fountain
attractions.description: Baroque fountain where tossing a coin is said to ensure a return to Rome.

attractions.name: Pantheon
attractions.description: Remarkably preserved Roman temple with a famous oculus dome.

attractions.name: Trastevere neighborhood
attractions.description: Charming cobblestone district known for trattorias and nightlife.

food.name: Cacio e pepe pasta
food.description: Classic Roman pasta with pecorino cheese and black pepper.

food.name: Roman-style pizza al taglio
food.description: Thin, crispy pizza sold by weight at local bakeries.

food.name: Gelato
food.description: Artisanal Italian ice cream, best from gelaterias away from major landmarks.

transport.description: Covers the compact metro and bus network.
Most central sights are within walking distance of each other.

travel_tips: Book Colosseum and Vatican tickets online in advance to skip long lines.
Dress modestly when visiting St. Peter's Basilica and the Vatican Museums.
Many restaurants near major sights are tourist traps; walk a few streets further for better value.
Validate paper transit tickets before boarding to avoid fines.
August can be very hot and many local businesses close for summer holidays.

overview: Singapore is a compact, ultra-modern city-state known for its futuristic gardens, diverse food culture, cleanliness, and efficient public transport, blending Chinese, Malay, Indian, and colonial influences.

attractions.name: Gardens by the Bay & Supertree Grove
attractions.description: Futuristic park with the Supertree light show and Cloud Forest dome.

attractions.name: Marina Bay Sands SkyPark
attractions.description: Rooftop infinity pool and observation deck with skyline views.

attractions.name: Sentosa Island
attractions.description: Resort island with beaches, Universal Studios, and adventure activities.

attractions.name: Chinatown & Sri Mariamman Temple
attractions.description: Historic district blending Chinese heritage shops with an ornate Hindu temple.

attractions.name: Hawker centre food trail (Maxwell/Lau Pa Sat)
attractions.description: Iconic open-air food courts serving affordable local dishes.

food.name: Hainanese Chicken Rice
food.description: Singapore's beloved hawker dish of poached chicken and fragrant rice.

food.name: Chili Crab
food.description: Iconic Singaporean dish of crab in a sweet-spicy tomato-chili sauce.

food.name: Laksa
food.description: Spicy coconut noodle soup, a Peranakan classic.

transport.description: Clean, efficient, and covers nearly the whole city.
Convenient for late nights or direct point-to-point travel.

travel_tips: Tap water is safe to drink directly from the tap.
Chewing gum import/sale is restricted; littering and jaywalking fines are strictly enforced.
Hawker centres offer the best value-for-money meals in the city.
Visit Gardens by the Bay in the evening to catch the light show for free from outside areas.
Public transport runs cheaply and reliably; renting a car is rarely necessary.
